formula: sum of exactly nine symptom values
weights: All 1; no normalization or weighted cognitive index

impairmentQuestion.invalidAnswerBehavior: Reject malformed impairment answers at the form-validation layer; no invented score for the functional response.

missingPolicy.rule: Missing symptom -> no total. No imputation, prorating, blank-to-zero, severity or screen label. Participants may skip/leave; no forced disclosure.

invalidPolicy: Reject strings (including numeric strings), booleans, fractions, out-of-range, null-as-an-answer, arrays and duplicate item responses. Missing means absence of an answer rather than an invalid response value.
safety: Nonzero item 9 requires further professional assessment regardless of missing other responses or total. Do not derive suicide intent/risk level; missing item 9 is unknown. Safety guidance always visible.
